tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Harnack's inequality, local form]

↗ def:ball-mean-value-property \group Harmonic Functions

Let $n\ge 1$, let $u\in C(U)$ be nonnegative with the ball mean-value property, and suppose $|x-y|\le r$ and $\overline{B(x,2r)}\subset U$. Then \[ u(y)\le 2^n u(x). \]
Proof

\sketch Since $B(y,r)\subset B(x,2r)$ and $u\ge 0$,

\[ u(x)=\fint _{B(x,2r)}u \ge \frac{|B(y,r)|}{|B(x,2r)|}\fint _{B(y,r)}u =2^{-n}u(y). \]

□
